editorial: Today, software development plugins and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Nginx are dominating the security agenda. With the announcement of Gemini 4 Neon, intensive technical work on video editing and language models on the Hugging Face platform is coming to the fore.

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository containing technical standards and official extensions for the code editor Cursor. Prepared with the TypeScript language, this resource aims to structure the plugin development processes for the platform.

snapshot.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a command-line interface tool that aims to make various software suitable for use by AI agents. It works compatibly with different platforms such as Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, the code editor Cursor, and Claude Code, enabling the integration of software processes into agent-based systems.

snapshot.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: One Command Line: Make any software agent-ready for Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 中文文档 | 日本語ドキュメント | Deutsch

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill offers an AI skill that summarizes topics by researching across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the general web. Developed with Python, this tool aims to provide the user with a reliable summary by synthesizing data collected from different platforms.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: getarcaneapp/arcane
items.summary: Arcane offers a modern interface developed for managing Docker containers. Written in the Go language, this tool aims to make Docker management accessible to everyone.

snapshot.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone. For setup instructions, configuration details, and development guides, visit the official documentation site.

items.title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
items.summary: SkillEvaluator, developed by NVIDIA, is a multi-layered framework that audits the capabilities and plugins of AI agents in terms of security, quality, and compliance. This tool, which can be integrated into software development processes, allows for measuring agent behaviors and the functionality of capabilities by creating synthetic datasets.

snapshot.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, security scanning, harness compatibility checks, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior. Ships reusable CI templates that bring every check to any repository.

items.title: nvm-sh/nvm
items.summary: nvm-sh/nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that allows you to quickly install and manage different Node.js versions via the command line. It enables developers to keep multiple Node.js versions active on their systems simultaneously.

snapshot.description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions. nvm allows you to quickly install and use different versions of node via the command line.

items.title: astral-sh/uv
items.summary: Developed with the Rust programming language, uv is a high-speed tool designed to manage Python packages and projects. It offers a performance-focused alternative to traditional package managers (pip, pip-tools).

snapshot.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust. An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.

items.title: google-research/paper-orchestra
items.summary: paper-orchestra, developed by Google Research, is a multi-agent framework that automatically converts ideas and experiment logs into academic papers. In addition to synthesizing literature, the software generates publication-ready LaTeX drafts that include visual content such as charts and conceptual diagrams.

snapshot.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials (ideas and experimental logs) into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams.

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: stitch-skills, developed by Google, is a library of agent skills designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library allows for the use of a standard capability structure in software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editor Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: sveltejs/svelte
items.summary: Svelte is a JavaScript tool used for developing web applications that, unlike traditional frameworks, works with a compiler logic. It converts written declarative components into efficient JavaScript code that directly updates the Document Object Model (DOM).

snapshot.description: web development for the rest of us. Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It's a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM.

items.title: jquery/jquery
items.summary: jQuery is a JavaScript library that makes it easier to create interactive elements on web pages. It provides tools that simplify how developers manipulate the Document Object Model (DOM) and manage events.

snapshot.description: jQuery JavaScript Library. The latest version of jQuery is available at

items.title: appwrite/appwrite
items.summary: Appwrite is an open-source cloud platform that brings together various tools such as authentication, database, storage, and hosting for developers and AI agents. Developed with TypeScript, this service offers a comprehensive infrastructure that simplifies application development processes.

snapshot.description: The open-source cloud for agents & devs. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtime, WAF and more

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
items.summary: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit used to optimize and deploy inference processes for AI models. Developed in C++, this platform enables models to run more efficiently on different hardware.

snapshot.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI agents that write code. It aims to standardize software development processes for agents through composable capabilities and guidance instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: JavaScript-based ECC is a system that combines components such as capability, instinct, memory, and security to optimize the performance of AI agents. It is designed to support research-oriented development on various platforms such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and the code editor tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

items.title: DeanChensj/jiangshan-map
items.summary: DeanChensj/jiangshan-map is an interactive historical atlas that allows for the examination of Chinese history through 18 dynasties and 198 different period maps. The project offers a timeline that visualizes settlement changes and classical poetry routes from 403 BC to the present day.

snapshot.description: 江山时序 · 中国历史交互地图时间轴 (403 BCE – Present) | Interactive Historical Atlas of China across 18 dynasties, 198 territory snapshots, ancient-to-modern place genealogy & classical poetry routes

items.title: n8n-io/n8n
items.summary: n8n is a workflow automation platform that combines a visual interface with custom code writing and offers local AI capabilities. With support for over 400 integrations, this platform provides users with the opportunity to work on their own servers or in the cloud.

snapshot.description: Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host or cloud, 400+ integrations.

items.title: solidjs/solid
items.summary: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library used to build user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates directly into real DOM nodes, performing updates with fine-grained reactivity.

snapshot.description: A declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactivity. Declare your state and use it throughout your app — when a piece of state changes, only the code that depends on it re-runs.

items.title: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers
items.summary: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers is a curated list of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It brings together various server applications developed for this protocol, which allows AI models to connect with different data sources.

snapshot.description: A collection of MCP servers. A curated list of awesome Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

items.summary: Remote code execution vulnerabilities that do not require authentication have been detected in the Nginx web server software. The vulnerabilities in question have been recorded under the codes CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007.

snapshot.description: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-123633https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-123007

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary: Google has announced Gemini 4 Neon, a new AI model that offers high-level intelligence in complex coding and analysis processes. The model in question aims to provide advanced performance at lower costs.

snapshot.description: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, delivering frontier-level intelligence for complex coding and analysis at a lower cost. See what's new.

items.title: DNS resolvers are the wrong place to fight piracy
items.summary: The non-profit DNS resolver Quad9 has ceased operations in France to avoid complying with the country's request to block access to beIN Sports broadcasts. This development opens up a debate on the technical and legal drawbacks of using public DNS services as content blocking tools.

snapshot.description: On November 24, 2026, the non-profit DNS resolver Quad9 stops serving users in France rather than obey a beIN Sports blocking order. Here's what Quad9 is, how the French law got here, and why forcing public resolvers to block domains breaks more than it fixes.

items.title: Inside Deutsche Bank
items.summary: Inside Deutsche Bank shares a comprehensive investigation examining the internal workings of the global financial institution Deutsche Bank. The platform offers a detailed review of the bank's operations.

snapshot.description: A major global investigation revealing the inner workings of the financial giant, Deutsche Bank.

items.title: Seven new models at scalable price-performance
items.summary: Microsoft has announced seven new AI models focused on scalable price and performance. These models were developed with a balance of cost and efficiency in mind for different use cases.

items.title: harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted is an image-text-to-text model customized for software development and terminal tasks. Built upon the Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B base model using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), this structure was developed with reinforcement learning support for the pi coding agent.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. A LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, trained with reinforcement learning to work as the model behind the pi coding agent on software-engineering and terminal tasks.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, Lightricks/LTX-2.5 is an image-to-video AI model that converts images into video. It allows users to transform static images into moving content.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small is a multimodal AI model that processes text and image inputs to produce text outputs. Supporting various programming languages in addition to English and other languages, this general-purpose model aims to establish interaction between different data types.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Inkling 2 Small is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages.

items.title: higurashi-ai/Haru-4B
items.summary: higurashi-ai/Haru-4B is an audio-to-audio AI model developed for voice-based interactions. With its low-latency and multilingual structure, this base model offers the ability to listen and speak simultaneously, similar to phone conversations, and is available for research purposes.

snapshot.description: audio-to-audio model. Haru-4B is a low-latency and multilingual full-duplex continuous spoken dialogue foundation model: it listens and speaks at the same time, the way people do on a phone call. It is a pretrained base model, released for research.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image, offered by MiniMaxAI, is an AI model that performs text-to-image conversion. The software is provided with API (a digital bridge that allows two different software programs to communicate with each other) documentation that supports image editing and prompt expansion features.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. API docs: - Text-to-image: EN-docs, CN-docs - Image editing: EN-docs, CN-docs - Prompt expansion: EN-docs, CN-docs

items.title: Late Entry in Looped Language Models
items.summary: Late Entry in Looped Language Models proposes a new method to increase inference depth in looped language models. This strategy, where new tokens skip the initial stages and enter directly into the final stages, aims to deepen the model's reasoning capacity while maintaining computational efficiency.

snapshot.description: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency. Conventional early-exit decoding halts after initial passes without cache completion, truncating cached key-value states of past tokens to shallow depth. items.title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
items.summary: RoughCut-Bench is an evaluation tool developed to automate the initial editing phase of raw footage in media production processes. It provides a comprehensive benchmark set to measure the capabilities of large vision-language models in creating video editing plans.

snapshot.description: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video case

items.title: Out of Sight, Still in Mind: Token Compression for Omni-LLMs
items.summary: The article published on Hugging Face aims to reduce the high input costs during inference for multimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs). The training-free framework called ReMo aims to compress visual tokens by filtering out redundant information in visual data and distributing it to other modes.

snapshot.description: The goal of this paper is to reduce the input token cost of Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) at inference time. Omni-LLMs reason jointly over audio, video and text, but the cost of the three streams is highly unbalanced: visual tokens account for the vast majority of the input, and are highly redundant. items.title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
items.summary: DrawScore is a method developed for evaluating computer-aided design (CAD) models against engineering drawings. It detects small-scale local errors ignored by existing metrics, offering more precise validation for manufacturing processes.

snapshot.description: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. items.title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
items.summary: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models addresses the credit assignment problem created by outcome-based reward methods in search-augmented language models. The study proposes a new approach that distributes credit based on the quality of the evidence obtained, rather than evaluating every step in the model's information-gathering process equally.

snapshot.description: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. glossary.explanation: Small add-on programs used to extend the existing features of a software or to add new functionalities.
Specialized capabilities that AI agents possess to perform a specific task.
A structural foundation that simplifies the software development process by providing a set of specific rules and tools.
A software infrastructure that enables multiple AI agents to collaborate with each other to complete complex tasks.
A collection of ready-to-use capabilities that allow AI agents to interact with external systems or perform specific operations.
A software tool that converts written source code into a more efficient format that the computer can execute directly.
The hierarchical structure that allows content on web pages to be processed and managed by the browser.
The process of a trained AI model making predictions or performing analysis on new data.
A type of software where the source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and enhance.
A coding approach where the programmer specifies what needs to be done, while the software handles how it is done.
A technique that manages updates through a lightweight copy of the actual web page structure held in memory.
A fast response mechanism that ensures only the relevant small part is updated when data on a web page changes.
A protocol that enables AI models to communicate with different data sources and tools in a standardized way.
A security vulnerability that allows attackers to remotely access a system and execute their own commands.
A system that translates website names into numerical addresses that computers understand.
An artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text data simultaneously to generate text-based responses based on them.
